title: delivery.release
description: Orders checkout hook, release. On a reserved intent any reason releases it (recorded; a later cancelled overwrites). Only reason cancelled undoes a commit: the order's shipment is cancelled if it has not left (pending/packed). checkout_failed / orphaned on a committed intent is a no-op answering ok. Output: {ok: true}. Idempotent.

actor_id.description: The acting account id (a guest's own id, or the account), always sent by orders that know it; user_id stays null for a guest. Owner of this brick's rows; absent from older orders payloads.
